Kay Kraft Brings Ekushey Collection
2023-02-13T19:14:30+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/news/kay-kraft-brings-ekushey-collection-3246741

Every year, we observe Language Martyrs Day with mourning, and deep respect. Kay Kraft has tried to capture the essence of the occasion into designing their clothing. Their Ekushey Collection will be presented at all outlets of Kay Kraft for the entire month of February customers.

This year's motifs are inspired by the history of the mother tongue; line motifs, tribal, textures, calligraphy. Apart from this, saris, shalwar kameez, kurti, long kurti, panjabi, shirt, t-shirt are made with traditional and geometric design and creatively embellished. For kids there are shalwar kameez, kurti, tops, panjabi, shirts.

Handwork, screen and block print and tie-dye media were used to bring out the designs on the handloom, cotton, linen, half silk fabrics. In terms of colours, the black of mourning, the red of the sun, the gray of melancholy, the white symbol of truth and purity have been taken.

The Ekushey collection can be ordered from Kay Kraft's online shop kaykraft.com and Facebook page in addition to all physical outlets.
